# audit.AuditLogEntry

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

An append-only audit record of an organization; lists changed field names, never values.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `audit.AuditLogEntry` |
| Kind | `entity` |
| PII | `personal` |
| Tenancy scope | `organization` |
| Permission | `core.audit-log.read` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | yes | `none` | What happened, SCREAMING_SNAKE past tense. |  |
| `actor` | yes | `personal` | Who did it. |  |
| `changes` | no | `none` | Names of the changed fields; never values. |  |
| `id` | yes | `none` | Automatic id of the entry. |  |
| `node` | no | `none` | Node the action happened at, when it has one. |  |
| `occurredAt` | yes | `none` | When the action happened (UTC). |  |
| `outcome` | yes | `none` | `denied` records refused attempts. |  |
| `reason` | no | `personal` | Reason given by the actor (impersonation, approvals). |  |
| `requestId` | yes | `none` | Request id (X-Request-Id) to correlate with logs. |  |
| `target` | yes | `personal` | What it was done to. |  |
| `tenantId` | yes | `none` | Organization the entry belongs to. |  |
| `traceId` | no | `none` | Trace id, when tracing is on. |  |

## Relations

- `belongs-to` `tenancy.Organization` via `tenantId`
